source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-attachment-without-scoping-entity-fails-closed.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: The gate can pass on a raw parser HINT with no uuid behind it. Probing crm_master_product_attachments_list without an attachment_type filter returns every attachment of every type, so a brochure-only product would be labelled 'has certificate'. With no UUID-shaped attachment_type/certificate entity anywhere the node must fail CLOSED: skip reason `no_scoping_entity` and an EMPTY dym_candidate_codes, even though a perfectly good product candidate was available.
